mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id, p.reservation_id, p.idempotency_key, p.provider, p.provider_payment_key, p.method, p.status, p.amount, p.currency_code, p.requested_at, p.approved_at FROM payments p JOIN reservations r ON r.reservation_id = p.reservation_id WHERE p.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT payment_id, reservation_id, idempotency_key, provider, provider_payment_key, method, status, amount, currency_code, requested_at, approved_at FROM payments WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT r.reservation_id, ri.reservation_item_id, r.status, r.total_amount, r.currency_code, r.expires_at, ri.usage_date, ri.usage_start_time, ri.quantity FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ri.reservation_item_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF r
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( reservation_id, idempotency_key, provider, method, status, amount, currency_code, approved_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{provider}, #{method}, 'PAID', #{amount}, #{currencyCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT t.issued_ticket_id, t.reservation_item_id, t.ticket_number, t.issue_method, t.status, t.valid_from, t.valid_until, t.issued_at FROM issued_tickets t JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_item_id = t.reservation_item_id WHERE ri.reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY t.issued_ticket_id

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_number, r.trip_id, r.user_id, r.status, r.total_amount, r.currency_code AS currency, r.request_key, ri.ticket_time_slot_id AS slot_id, ri.product_name, ri.option_name, ri.usage_date, ri.usage_start_time, ri.quantity, ri.unit_price FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_items ri ON ri.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY ri.reservation_item_id LIMIT 1
